body:
Screwhorn Goat CR 1

This goat has incredible spiraling horns that extend upward from it’s head.

XP 400
N Medium animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +3 (1d6+3)
Special Attacks powerful charge (gore, 1d10+3)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 7
Base Attack +1; CMB +3; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Bull Rush(B), Skill Focus (Acrobatics)
Skills Acrobatics +13 (+17 jump), Perception +6; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping

ECOLOGY

Environment arid mountains
Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3–30)
Treasure none

While called a screwhorn goat, these bulky animals are more akin to rams with their strength, aggression and deadly horns. The upward-spiraling pattern of the horns makes them more deadly than their mundane counterparts. Otherwise, in patterns of behavior, diet and herd-groupings, they are very similar to rams.
